thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired for service=inference-api-prod, severity=SEV2. Trigger: 503 spike on /v1/generate (alerting rule: 5m error_rate > 3%). Deploy tag: release-2024.11.3. Related: recent rollout to eu-west-1.
PagerDuty: Incident 84612 created and notified: primary oncall SRE Oncall. Escalation level: 1 -> 2 in 10m if unack. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/84612
SRE Oncall: acked the page. I'm looking at logs and k8s pods. Starting triage.
Anya Patel: seeing 503 rate from the edge LB -> inference gateway chain. P95 latency is normal for successful requests. Errors concentrated on models/transformer/embedding endpoint.
Dan Morris: copying runbook: "inference-api-prod: high 5xx after deploy". First steps: check canary subset, check rollout status, look for config flips.
Leo Chen: k8s rollout status shows 27/30 pods ready in eu-west-1, but 4 pods restarting with OOMKilled over last 12m. Logs show repeated OOM in loader-worker: "std::bad_alloc".
Janine Rivera: support reports two customers (customerA, customerB) seeing elevated 503s in EU. No billing impact yet but request retries spike.
SRE Oncall: running quick metric queries. Metric summary (last 15m): total requests +12%, 5xx rate 4.7% (baseline 0.2%). Affected region: eu-west-1 ~78% of errors.
Anya Patel: can we temporarily divert eu-west-1 traffic to eu-central-1 and scale pool? We have capacity in eu-central for burst.
Dan Morris: agree. Mitigation options: 1) roll back release-2024.11.3 in eu-west-1, 2) rollforward patch that pins memory limits + ramp 2x, 3) traffic diversion to eu-central-1. Rollback will reduce risk but take longer for stateful warming.
incident-bot: :information_source: Runbook step executed: increased pod memory limit for deployment/inference-gateway to 6Gi -> applying update to eu-west-1 (canary group only). Command: ```kubectl -n prod set resources deploy/inference-gateway --limits=memory=6Gi --requests=2Gi```
Leo Chen: applied canary resource bump to 3 pods. Monitoring logs... new pods not OOMing yet. 503 rate on canary subset down to 0.6% within 90s. Good signal.
PagerDuty: Escalation timer paused by SRE Oncall.
SRE Oncall: starting staged rollforward: patch resource limits across remaining eu-west-1 pools over 10m window, with healthchecks and traffic steering. If errors persist after full rollforward, we'll rollback.
Janine Rivera: informing support triage: "We're mitigating a 503 spike in EU — diverting traffic and applying a resource patch. We'll update customerA/customerB within 30m."
Anya Patel: posting dashboards: Grafana link https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/inference-prod?orgId=1&env=prod&var-region=eu-west-1. Build logs: https://ci.internal/job/2024.11.3/console
Dan Morris: logs show a recent change in tokenizer init that increases peak memory under certain sequences. Related commit: sha=fa5b9d2. Flagging engineering for postmortem.
Leo Chen: rolling patch completed across all eu-west-1 replicas. 5xx rate now 0.5% region-wide. Latency stable.
SRE Oncall: traffic diversion completed: clipped 30% of eu-west traffic to eu-central while certifying warmup. Diversion commands: ```trafficctl route modify inference-api-prod --region eu-west-1 --divert eu-central-1 --pct 30```
PagerDuty: Noting timeline. Incident 84612 -> status: mitigation in progress. Next escalation in 30m if regress.
Anya Patel: monitoring customer error counts. CustomerA error rate back to baseline after retries; CustomerB still seeing elevated retries (10% of requests). Janine, please escalate CustomerB to CSM so they are aware.
Janine Rivera: on it. Pinged CSM and sent templated update to CustomerB.
SRE Oncall: quick impact assessment: approx 2.4% overall requests affected during window, peak concurrent errors ~1200rps, main impact EU region. No data loss. Estimated affected customers: 8 with >1% failure rate.
Dan Morris: decision: no full rollback. Continue rollforward + monitor. Open a follow-up ticket to revert the tokenizer change or add guardrails. Triage owners: Dan (eng), Leo (sre), Anya (product infra).
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation steps applied. Please update this thread with any new regressions.
SRE Oncall: handing off to night oncall at 1709126400 (handoff ts). Summary for handoff: mitigation done (resource bump + traffic diversion). Watch for regress in next 2 hours.
Anya Patel: creating post-incident issue: infra/84612-tokenizer-memory-regression. Assigning to Dan and Leo.
Janine Rivera: Customer update posted at 17:48 UTC.
Leo Chen: perf note: we should consider adding a memory-pressure watcher to signal preemptive scaling for tokenizer-heavy requests.
Dan Morris: agreed. Also will add an automated circuit breaker for tokenizer sequences > 4096 tokens.
SRE Oncall: closing the PagerDuty timeline as 'mitigated'. Incident will remain open for postmortem. Final metrics snapshot: 5xx avg 0.3% last 30m, p95 latency +2% vs baseline.
PagerDuty: Incident 84612 status updated to "Mitigated - monitoring".
Anya Patel: thanks team. Postmortem draft requested within 48 hours. :raised_hands:
SRE Oncall: leaving a short raw timeline below for postmortem notes:
```
17:20:12 UTC incident-bot pager fired - 503 spike
17:21:00 SRE Oncall ack
17:22:30 Identified OOM on loader-worker pods in eu-west-1
17:25:10 Applied memory bump to canary -> 503s drop
17:30:00 Rolled patch region-wide
17:33:45 Diversion 30% traffic to eu-central-1
17:40:00 5xx rate near baseline, mitigation complete
17:48:00 Customer updates posted
```
SRE Oncall: postmortem will include RCA: tokenizer commit fa5b9d2 increased peak memory under specific sequences and insufficient guardrails in resource requests. Next steps tracked in infra/84612-ticket.
Anya Patel: closing thread for live mitigation. Will reopen if we see regress. :lock:
